question: Town G is to the south of Town H. Town I is to the east of Town H. Town J is to the west of Town I. Town K is to the north of Town J. Town G is to the south-east of Town K. What is the position of Town H with respect to Town J?
solution:
Given:

Town G is to the south of Town H.

Town I is to the east of Town H.

Town J is to the west of Town I.

Town K is to the north of Town J.

Town G is to the south-east of Town K.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa38b7edc28b66955aeeabdd57bc8171ff679d31d8d8e00707435d579edc47c4.png] ​

Thus, Town H is to the east of Town J.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
